linear_motor.description: An ironcore linear motor that drives an axis with no transmission (transmission::LinearMotor). Its motor's values read in N for N m and m for rad ([motor.<id>]: force constant in N/A, the forcer's mass as rotor_inertia_kgm2); its gearbox values ([gearbox.<id>], ratio 1) are the forcer's mounting.

linkage.description: A parallel linkage of driven arms, each with a pair of forearms (a parallelogram) down to a plate that keeps its orientation. Two arms (crate sim-netlist, linkage.rs): in the vertical x-z plane, one at each side of the base (the planar delta); the tool is the plate's centre, x and z. Three arms (spatial.rs): at 0, 120 and 240 degrees round the base (the spatial delta); the tool is x, y and z. A file with a linkage has as many axes as arms (no stroke: the working range below sets their range), one motor per arm, a gearbox on each and the linkage; nothing else, and no belt effect on. The arms' joints read [joint] (bearing friction, stops), each motor its drive train as everywhere.

arms.description: The gearboxes that turn the arms: two (the first the arm at +x, the second the one at -x) or three (at 0, 120 and 240 degrees from +x). Ids of machine.gearbox nodes.
